templates.title: Verify your email address
templates.subject: Verify your email for Zoiko iD
templates.preheader: Finish confirming that this email address belongs to you.
paragraphs: We received a request to use this email address with Zoiko iD.
To confirm it, select the button below before {{expires_at_local}}. The link is single-use. If you did not request this, you can ignore this message; no verification will be completed.
templates.control: Do not expose account existence at public request endpoint.

templates.title: Email verified; account ready
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD email is verified
templates.preheader: Your email verification is complete.
paragraphs: Your email address has been confirmed for your Zoiko iD profile.
You can now open your account to review available identity, credential, consent and security settings. Additional verification may be required before certain services become available.

templates.title: Welcome to Zoiko iD
templates.subject: Welcome to Zoiko iD
templates.preheader: A secure place to manage identity and authority.
paragraphs: Welcome to Zoiko iD, the trust layer between identity and action.

From your account, you can manage permitted sign-in methods, review verification status, see credentials issued to you, and understand where you have granted or received authority. Availability depends on your organization and enabled services.

templates.title: Invitation to join an organization
templates.subject: {{inviter_name}} invited you to {{organization_name}}
templates.preheader: Review an invitation to join an organization on Zoiko iD.
paragraphs: {{inviter_name}} has invited you to join {{organization_name}} using Zoiko iD as {{invited_role_label}}.

To accept, review the organization and the access being offered before {{expires_at_local}}. Accepting does not give you more permissions than those approved by the organization. If this invitation is unexpected, do not accept it.

templates.title: Pending invitation reminder
templates.subject: Your invitation to {{organization_name}} is still open
templates.preheader: You can review or decline the invitation.
paragraphs: Your invitation to join {{organization_name}} on Zoiko iD is awaiting your decision.
The invitation expires at {{expires_at_local}}. You can review the proposed role before choosing whether to join. If you were not expecting an invitation, no action is needed.
templates.control: Send only when reminders are permitted and the invitation remains valid.

templates.title: Invitation expired
templates.subject: Your invitation to {{organization_name}} expired
templates.preheader: The invitation link can no longer be used.
paragraphs: The invitation to join {{organization_name}} on Zoiko iD expired at {{expired_at_local}}.
If you still need access, contact the person who invited you or your organization administrator. For your security, the previous invitation link is no longer active.

templates.title: Invitation accepted – organizer
templates.subject: {{member_display_name}} joined {{organization_name}}
templates.preheader: The invitation was accepted.
paragraphs: {{member_display_name}} accepted the invitation to join {{organization_name}} at {{event_at_local}}.
Their effective permissions are governed by the approved role and current policies. You can review the membership record and audit history in the organization console.

templates.title: Invitation declined – organizer
templates.subject: Invitation declined for {{organization_name}}
templates.preheader: The invited person chose not to join.
paragraphs: The invitation sent to {{invitee_masked_email}} for {{organization_name}} was declined at {{event_at_local}}.
No membership was activated from this invitation. You can close the request or issue a new invitation if the recipient later agrees.

templates.title: One-time sign-in code
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD sign-in code
templates.preheader: Use this code only in the sign-in flow you started.
paragraphs: Your one-time sign-in code is: {{one_time_code}}
Enter it only on the Zoiko iD sign-in screen you opened. The code expires at {{expires_at_local}} and can be used once.
If you did not try to sign in, do not share the code. Review account activity using a saved bookmark or a trusted sign-in path.
templates.control: Email codes are not phishing-resistant MFA; gate by policy and risk.

templates.title: Single-use sign-in link
templates.subject: Your secure Zoiko iD sign-in link
templates.preheader: Use this link to complete the sign-in you started.
paragraphs: We received a request for a single-use sign-in link.
Select the button below before {{expires_at_local}} to continue. If you did not request the link, ignore this email. Never forward the message or share the link with anyone.
templates.control: Use only where the authentication policy permits link-based sign-in.

templates.title: Password reset link
templates.subject: Reset your Zoiko iD password
templates.preheader: A single-use link is available if you made this request.
paragraphs: A password-reset request was received for a Zoiko iD account associated with this address.

If you initiated the request, select the button below before {{expires_at_local}}. The link is single-use. If you did not request a reset, you do not need to use the link and should review your account security.
templates.control: Never confirm account existence on request endpoint; not sent for federated-only identities without password.

templates.title: Password changed
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD password was changed
templates.preheader: Review the change if it was not yours.
paragraphs: The password for your Zoiko iD account was changed at {{event_at_local}}.

If you made this change, no further action is needed. If you did not, open Zoiko iD from a trusted bookmark and start the account recovery process immediately. Any active-session handling follows your account security policy.

templates.title: Recovery request submitted
templates.subject: Zoiko iD account recovery started
templates.preheader: We have received an account recovery request.
paragraphs: An account recovery process was initiated at {{event_at_local}}.

The request is under the applicable verification and risk checks. Starting recovery does not restore access or change your authenticators. If this was not you, contact support through the official Zoiko iD site.

templates.title: Recovery needs additional proof
templates.subject: Additional verification needed for recovery
templates.preheader: Complete the next required identity check.
paragraphs: We need an additional verification step before your Zoiko iD recovery request can proceed.
Sign in to the secure recovery flow to see the permitted proof options and the deadline, if any. Do not send identity documents, codes, or recovery details in reply to this email.

templates.title: Recovery completed
templates.subject: Zoiko iD account recovery completed
templates.preheader: Access has been restored under the recovery policy.
paragraphs: Your Zoiko iD recovery was completed at {{event_at_local}}.

Review your authenticators, recovery options, recent activity and active sessions when you next sign in. If you did not initiate this process, report it immediately through the official support route.

templates.title: Recovery not approved
templates.subject: Update on your Zoiko iD recovery request
templates.preheader: The request could not be completed.
paragraphs: We could not approve your account recovery request under the current verification requirements.
For your protection, this email does not describe the specific risk signals. You can review the permitted next steps in the recovery center or contact support using the reference {{case_reference}}.

templates.title: Verify new email address
templates.subject: Confirm your new Zoiko iD email address
templates.preheader: Verify this address to continue the change.
paragraphs: A request was made to update the email address on a Zoiko iD profile.
If you requested this change, confirm the new address using the single-use link below before {{expires_at_local}}. The account will not use the new address until all required checks succeed.

templates.title: Email change requested – existing address
templates.subject: A change to your Zoiko iD email was requested
templates.preheader: Protect your account if this was unexpected.
paragraphs: A request to change the email address associated with your Zoiko iD account was initiated at {{event_at_local}}.
If you did not initiate it, open your account from a trusted sign-in path or contact support immediately. This message is a warning; do not approve a change from an unexpected message.

templates.title: Email address changed
templates.to: Account owner / old and new address
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD email address was changed
templates.preheader: The email update is complete.
paragraphs: The email address associated with your Zoiko iD account was changed at {{event_at_local}}.
If you approved the change, no action is necessary. If you did not, start the secure recovery process immediately. For privacy, this message does not display the full previous or new address.

templates.title: New sign-in detected
templates.subject: New sign-in to your Zoiko iD account
templates.preheader: Review a sign-in from a new device or context.
paragraphs: A sign-in to your Zoiko iD account was completed at {{event_at_local}} from {{device_summary}}.
If this was you, no action is needed. If it was not, use your trusted sign-in path to revoke sessions and secure your authenticators. Location information, when shown, is approximate.

templates.title: Unusual sign-in blocked
templates.subject: We blocked an unusual Zoiko iD sign-in attempt
templates.preheader: Your account was protected by a security check.
paragraphs: A sign-in attempt at {{event_at_local}} was blocked by Zoiko iD security controls.
No access was granted through that attempt. If it was you, open Zoiko iD directly and follow the safe sign-in guidance. If you do not recognize the activity, review your security settings.

templates.title: Sessions signed out
templates.subject: Zoiko iD sessions were signed out
templates.preheader: A security-related sign-out was completed.
paragraphs: One or more active sessions were ended at {{event_at_local}} because {{reason_public_label}}.
If you initiated this, you may sign in again through your usual method. If not, review the account recovery and security options through the official Zoiko iD site.

templates.title: Authenticator enrolled
templates.subject: A new sign-in method was added to Zoiko iD
templates.preheader: Review the new authenticator.
paragraphs: A {{authenticator_type_public}} sign-in method was added to your Zoiko iD account at {{event_at_local}}.
If you added it, no action is needed. If you did not, report the change immediately and secure your account through a trusted channel.

templates.title: Authenticator removed
templates.subject: A Zoiko iD sign-in method was removed
templates.preheader: A change to your account protection was made.
paragraphs: A {{authenticator_type_public}} sign-in method was removed from your Zoiko iD account at {{event_at_local}}.
If you did not make this change, use the recovery or security process immediately. We never ask you to send authenticator secrets or recovery codes by email.

templates.title: Account access temporarily restricted
templates.subject: Zoiko iD account access is temporarily restricted
templates.preheader: A security check is required before access continues.
paragraphs: Access to your Zoiko iD account is temporarily restricted from {{event_at_local}}.
To protect your privacy and security, the specific detection logic is not included in this message. Open the secure account center for available verification or appeal options.

templates.title: Identity verification initiated
templates.subject: Identity verification started
templates.preheader: Your verification process is underway.
paragraphs: Your Zoiko iD identity verification process was started at {{event_at_local}}.
You can review the current status and outstanding steps in the secure verification center. Starting the process does not mean your identity has been verified.

templates.title: Identity information required
templates.subject: More information is needed for verification
templates.preheader: Complete the request inside Zoiko iD.
paragraphs: Additional information is needed to continue the verification request with reference {{case_reference}}.
Please open the secure verification center to see the exact requirements and submission deadline. Do not reply with identity documents, selfies, government numbers or other sensitive materials.

templates.title: Verification submission received
templates.subject: We received your verification submission
templates.preheader: The review is awaiting a decision.
paragraphs: Your requested verification information was received at {{event_at_local}}.
The review is not yet complete. We will notify you if further steps are required or when the decision is available in your secure account.

templates.title: Verification approved
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD verification review is complete
templates.preheader: The outcome is available in your secure profile.
paragraphs: The verification review for reference {{case_reference}} was completed with an approved outcome at {{event_at_local}}.
Open Zoiko iD to review the specific verified attributes, assurance level, validity period and any permitted next steps. Approval is not a blanket guarantee for every relying party.

templates.title: Verification not approved
templates.subject: An update on your identity verification
templates.preheader: Review the decision and available next steps.
paragraphs: Your identity verification request {{case_reference}} could not be approved under the applicable requirements.
For privacy and security, the full decision explanation is available only in your protected verification center, together with any correction or review options.

templates.title: Reverification required
templates.subject: Action required: review your identity verification
templates.preheader: Your current verification needs renewal.
paragraphs: Your current verification status needs review by {{due_at_local}} because {{reason_public_label}}.
Use the secure verification center to complete the permitted checks. Access to some actions may change if the review is not completed by the deadline.

templates.title: Verification review requested
templates.subject: Your verification review request was received
templates.preheader: We have recorded your request to reconsider the outcome.
paragraphs: Your request to review verification decision {{case_reference}} was received at {{event_at_local}}.
You can follow the case in the secure verification center. A review request does not automatically reverse a decision or restore restricted access.

templates.title: Verification review outcome available
templates.subject: Your verification review decision is available
templates.preheader: Sign in to view the outcome securely.
paragraphs: The review of verification decision {{case_reference}} is complete.
To protect your information, the decision details and next steps are available in the secure verification center rather than in this email.

templates.title: Organization verification started
templates.subject: Organization verification started for {{organization_name}}
templates.preheader: Track the status in your organization console.
paragraphs: The organization verification process for {{organization_name}} began at {{event_at_local}}.
You can review verification stages and outstanding requirements in the secured organization console. The organization is not represented as approved until the process is complete.

templates.title: Organization documents or controllers required
templates.subject: Additional organization details required
templates.preheader: Complete the checklist securely.
paragraphs: We need additional organizational information to continue verification reference {{case_reference}} for {{organization_name}}.

A permitted administrator should open the secure console for the required documents, ownership information or authorized representative details. Do not send personal or corporate verification records as email attachments.

templates.title: Organization verification approved
templates.subject: Verification completed for {{organization_name}}
templates.preheader: Approved attributes are available in the console.
paragraphs: The organization verification review for {{organization_name}} has been approved at {{event_at_local}}.
Review the verified details, scope, validity period and any outstanding operational controls in the organization console. This outcome does not confer permissions outside the approved scope.

templates.title: Organization verification not approved
templates.subject: Organization verification decision available
templates.preheader: Sign in to review the decision.
paragraphs: The verification review for {{organization_name}} is complete, but approval was not granted under the applicable requirements.
An authorized administrator can securely view the decision, permissible corrections and any review pathway using case {{case_reference}}.

templates.title: Periodic organization review due
templates.subject: Periodic review due for {{organization_name}}
templates.preheader: Refresh required records before the due date.
paragraphs: A scheduled verification review is due for {{organization_name}} by {{due_at_local}}.
A permitted administrator should review the verification profile and submit any requested updates in the secure console.
Outstanding review requirements may affect access to selected regulated or high-trust workflows.

templates.title: Credential issued
templates.subject: A new credential is available in Zoiko iD
templates.preheader: Review the credential and its issuer.
paragraphs: A credential titled {{credential_public_label}} was issued to your Zoiko iD wallet by {{issuer_display_name}} at {{event_at_local}}.
Open the secure wallet to review its issuer, permitted claims, status, validity and sharing settings. This email does not include the credential or its sensitive contents.

templates.title: Credential issuance needs acceptance
templates.subject: Review a credential offered to you
templates.preheader: Accept or decline the credential in your wallet.
paragraphs: {{issuer_display_name}} has offered a credential labeled {{credential_public_label}} to your Zoiko iD wallet.
You can review the issuing organization, the proposed information and any acceptance requirements before {{expires_at_local}}. No acceptance is recorded until you confirm in the secure experience.

templates.title: Credential nearing expiry
templates.subject: Credential renewal may be needed
templates.preheader: A credential is approaching the end of its validity.
paragraphs: Your {{credential_public_label}} credential is scheduled to expire at {{expires_at_local}}.
Review the credential and any renewal options in your wallet. A replacement is not automatic unless the issuer and the applicable policy explicitly support it.

templates.title: Credential expired
templates.subject: A Zoiko iD credential has expired
templates.preheader: Review available renewal steps.
paragraphs: Your {{credential_public_label}} credential expired at {{event_at_local}}.
It may no longer be accepted for transactions that require a currently valid credential. Open your wallet to review the status and issuer-supported renewal route.

templates.title: Credential suspended
templates.subject: A credential has been suspended
templates.preheader: A change to credential status requires your attention.
paragraphs: The issuer has suspended your {{credential_public_label}} credential effective {{event_at_local}}.
Its acceptance may be restricted while this status applies. View the secure credential record for approved next steps and issuer contact options.

templates.title: Credential revoked
templates.subject: A credential has been revoked
templates.preheader: The credential is no longer valid for new presentations.
paragraphs: The issuer revoked the {{credential_public_label}} credential effective {{event_at_local}}.
Please review the secure record and any permitted reissuance or dispute options. Previously completed transactions are not automatically undone by this status change.

templates.title: Credential reinstated
templates.subject: Your credential status has changed
templates.preheader: A credential is active again under issuer policy.
paragraphs: The issuer has reinstated the {{credential_public_label}} credential as of {{event_at_local}}.
Review current validity, permitted claims and any conditions in your wallet before presenting it again.

templates.title: Credential presentation approval requested
templates.subject: Approve a credential presentation request
templates.preheader: Decide what information to share.
paragraphs: {{relying_party_display_name}} requested permission to receive selected credential information for {{purpose_public_label}}.
Open the protected request to review the specific attributes, recipient, expiry and reuse conditions. No information should be shared unless the required consent and authorization checks pass.

templates.title: Credential presentation receipt
templates.subject: Credential information was shared
templates.preheader: A receipt is available in your Zoiko iD history.
paragraphs: A credential presentation involving {{relying_party_display_name}} was completed at {{event_at_local}} under authorization reference {{receipt_reference}}.
Review the secure receipt to see which claims were disclosed, the purpose and the recorded authorization. Sensitive attributes are not repeated in this email.

templates.title: Verification request completed – relying party
templates.subject: Credential verification result available
templates.preheader: Open the secured record for the result.
paragraphs: The credential verification request {{case_reference}} for {{relying_party_display_name}} completed at {{event_at_local}}.
An authorized user may review the result, validation rules and supporting evidence reference in the console. No raw identity attributes or evidence attachments are included in this email.

templates.title: Credential status check needs attention
templates.subject: Action needed: credential status validation
templates.preheader: A status check did not complete as expected.
paragraphs: A credential status validation for issuer {{issuer_display_name}} encountered an issue at {{event_at_local}}.
Review the affected integration and applicable fail-safe behavior in the console. Do not assume that a missing status response means a credential is valid.

templates.title: Consent decision requested
templates.subject: {{requester_name}} requests your permission
templates.preheader: Review the intended use before deciding.
paragraphs: {{requester_name}} has requested permission to use specified information for {{purpose_public_label}}.
Review the exact data categories, duration, recipient and withdrawal method in your Zoiko iD consent center. You may decline unless a separate lawful or contractual requirement applies.

templates.title: Consent granted – receipt
templates.subject: Your permission choice was saved
templates.preheader: You can review or change eligible permissions.
paragraphs: Your permission to {{requester_name}} for {{purpose_public_label}} was recorded at {{event_at_local}}.
Receipt reference: {{receipt_reference}}. Your secure consent record contains the authorized scope, expiry or review date, and applicable withdrawal options.

templates.title: Consent declined – requester notice
templates.subject: Permission request was not approved
templates.preheader: No access was authorized through the request.
paragraphs: Your request {{case_reference}} for permission relating to {{purpose_public_label}} was not approved.
Do not proceed with the proposed access on the basis of this request. Review permitted alternative lawful and operational routes in your organization console.

templates.title: Consent renewal required
templates.subject: Review a permission before it expires
templates.preheader: Your current authorization needs a new decision.
paragraphs: An authorization for {{requester_name}} relating to {{purpose_public_label}} requires review by {{due_at_local}}.
Open the consent center to check the requested scope and decide whether to continue it. An expired authorization must not be treated as renewed automatically.

templates.title: Consent withdrawn – receipt
templates.subject: Your permission withdrawal was recorded
templates.preheader: A receipt is ready in your consent history.
paragraphs: Your withdrawal of permission for {{requester_name}} and {{purpose_public_label}} was recorded at {{event_at_local}}.

Receipt reference: {{receipt_reference}}. Future processing that relies on this consent must follow the recorded revocation and propagation policy; any independent lawful basis or retention requirement will be explained in the secure center.

templates.title: Consent withdrawn – relying party
templates.subject: An authorization you rely on was withdrawn
templates.preheader: Review the affected access without delay.
paragraphs: Authorization {{authorization_reference}} for {{purpose_public_label}} was withdrawn effective {{event_at_local}}.

Stop new consent-dependent processing within the applicable policy window and review any downstream revocation obligations. The secure console contains the affected scope without exposing unnecessary personal information.

templates.title: Permission expired
templates.subject: An authorization has expired
templates.preheader: Access based on that authorization is no longer active.
paragraphs: Authorization {{authorization_reference}} for {{purpose_public_label}} expired at {{event_at_local}}.
A new authorization is required before further activity that depends on that permission. Review the historical receipt and any renewal process in Zoiko iD.

templates.title: Data export request acknowledged
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD data request was received
templates.preheader: Track the request securely.
paragraphs: We received your personal data access or export request at {{event_at_local}} and recorded reference {{case_reference}}.
We may need to verify your identity before releasing information. You can follow progress and see applicable timelines in the secure privacy center.

templates.title: Data export ready
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD data export is ready
templates.preheader: Retrieve the export through a secure, time-limited flow.
paragraphs: Your data export for request {{case_reference}} is ready for secure retrieval.
Open the privacy center before {{expires_at_local}} and complete any required verification. The export is not attached to this email. If the retrieval window expires, request a new secure delivery.

templates.title: Correction request acknowledged
templates.subject: Your information correction request was received
templates.preheader: You can follow the review online.
paragraphs: We have received your request to correct information associated with Zoiko iD, reference {{case_reference}}.
Some information may depend on an external issuer or organization; your secure privacy center will show what Zoiko iD can change and what requires third-party review.

templates.title: Correction decision available
templates.subject: Update on your information correction request
templates.preheader: View the outcome and any remaining action.
paragraphs: The review of correction request {{case_reference}} is complete.
Open the privacy center to see the outcome, any changes made, information we cannot amend directly, and the available escalation route.

templates.title: Deletion request acknowledged
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD deletion request was received
templates.preheader: Review what happens next.
paragraphs: Your deletion request was received at {{event_at_local}}, reference {{case_reference}}.

We will review applicable verification, retention, security, legal and third-party obligations before confirming which information can be deleted. Submitting a request does not immediately erase audit evidence or externally issued records.

templates.title: Deletion request outcome
templates.subject: Your Zoiko iD deletion request has an outcome
templates.preheader: View the completed actions and any exceptions.
paragraphs: The review of deletion request {{case_reference}} is complete.
Your privacy center provides an itemized outcome, including information removed, retained under applicable obligations, or controlled by other organizations, together with review options.

templates.title: Privacy inquiry case update
templates.subject: An update on privacy case {{case_reference}}
templates.preheader: A response or action is available.
paragraphs: There is an update on your Zoiko iD privacy inquiry {{case_reference}}.
For confidentiality, the details and any response requirements are available only in your secure privacy center.

templates.title: Authority request sent to principal
templates.subject: Review a delegated authority request
templates.preheader: A person or organization has requested defined authority.
paragraphs: {{delegate_display_name}} has requested authority to act for {{principal_public_label}} within {{mandate_scope_public}}.
Review the permitted actions, effective period, limits, evidence requirements and revocation terms before approving. No authority is active merely because the request was sent.

templates.title: Authority accepted by principal
templates.subject: Delegated authority approved
templates.preheader: Review the exact scope before acting.
paragraphs: {{principal_public_label}} approved mandate {{mandate_reference}} at {{event_at_local}}.
The permitted actions, limits, validity and any step-up checks are recorded in Zoiko iD. Do not act outside the approved authority or assume it applies to other organizations.

templates.title: Authority rejected
templates.subject: Delegated authority request not approved
templates.preheader: No authority was created by this request.
paragraphs: Mandate request {{mandate_reference}} was not approved.
You must not perform actions on behalf of {{principal_public_label}} under this request. If appropriate, submit a new request that reflects the actual authorization required.

templates.title: Mandate activated – principal
templates.subject: Delegated authority is now active
templates.preheader: Review who can act and within which limits.
paragraphs: Mandate {{mandate_reference}} became active at {{event_at_local}} for {{delegate_display_name}}.
Scope: {{mandate_scope_public}}. Review the authority record, expiry and revocation controls at any time. The delegate is still subject to policy checks on each protected action.

templates.title: Mandate nearing expiry
templates.subject: Delegated authority is nearing expiry
templates.preheader: Renewal requires a new decision where applicable.
paragraphs: Mandate {{mandate_reference}} is scheduled to expire at {{expires_at_local}}.
Review outstanding work and any permissible renewal route. Expiry ends the authority; it does not silently extend because a related task remains open.

templates.title: Mandate expired
templates.subject: Delegated authority has expired
templates.preheader: New actions require valid authority.
paragraphs: Mandate {{mandate_reference}} expired at {{event_at_local}}.
New actions cannot rely on this mandate. Existing actions and their historical evidence remain subject to the applicable record policies.

templates.title: Mandate revoked – principal receipt
templates.subject: Delegated authority revoked
templates.preheader: Your revocation was recorded.
paragraphs: You revoked mandate {{mandate_reference}} at {{event_at_local}}.
The revocation record is available under receipt {{receipt_reference}}. New actions requiring that mandate are blocked according to the revocation propagation policy.

templates.title: Mandate revoked – delegate notice
templates.subject: Your delegated authority has been revoked
templates.preheader: Stop acting under this mandate.
paragraphs: Mandate {{mandate_reference}} was revoked effective {{event_at_local}}.
Do not initiate new actions that rely on this authority. Review the mandate record for affected permissions and any handoff instructions.

templates.title: Change of authority scope requested
templates.subject: A change to delegated authority needs approval
templates.preheader: Review new privileges and limits.
paragraphs: A change has been proposed to mandate {{mandate_reference}}.
Proposed change: {{scope_change_public_summary}}. Existing permissions are unchanged until the revised scope is explicitly approved and activated under policy.

templates.title: Authority scope changed
templates.subject: Delegated authority permissions changed
templates.preheader: Review the current mandate limits.
paragraphs: The approved scope of mandate {{mandate_reference}} changed at {{event_at_local}}.
Current scope: {{mandate_scope_public}}. Actions after the effective time will be evaluated against this revised authorization and all relevant policies.

templates.title: High-risk action approval requested
templates.subject: Approval requested for a protected action
templates.preheader: Verify the context before authorizing.
paragraphs: A protected action requiring your decision was requested for {{organization_name}}.
Action: {{action_public_label}}. Reference: {{action_reference}}. Review its initiator, scoped authority, policy checks and expiry in the secure approval center. Do not approve from email alone.

templates.title: Protected action approved – requester
templates.subject: Your protected action was approved
templates.preheader: Approval is recorded but execution may still require checks.
paragraphs: Approval for action {{action_reference}} was granted at {{event_at_local}}.
The action will proceed only if the required authority, policy and execution checks remain valid. Review the secure record for the final execution state and audit receipt.

templates.title: Protected action denied or timed out
templates.subject: Protected action was not approved
templates.preheader: No authorized execution followed this request.
paragraphs: The approval request for action {{action_reference}} was {{decision_public_label}} at {{event_at_local}}.
The requested action cannot proceed under that approval. You can view the permitted resubmission steps in the secure console.

templates.title: Machine identity created
templates.subject: A new machine identity was created
templates.preheader: Review the service identity and owner.
paragraphs: A non-human identity called {{agent_display_name}} was created for {{organization_name}} at {{event_at_local}}.
Review its owning team, approved purpose, environment and initial privilege boundaries. Credentials and secrets are never included in this email.

templates.title: AI-agent identity registered
templates.subject: AI-agent identity registered in Zoiko iD
templates.preheader: Review accountable ownership and intended authority.
paragraphs: AI-agent identity {{agent_display_name}} was registered for {{organization_name}} at {{event_at_local}}.
Review its designated owner, purpose, risk tier and permitted integrations. Registration alone does not authorize the agent to act or grant production privileges.

templates.title: Agent authority requested
templates.subject: Approval needed for AI-agent authority
templates.preheader: Check the proposed capabilities and constraints.
paragraphs: A new authority grant has been requested for AI agent {{agent_display_name}}.
Requested scope: {{mandate_scope_public}}. Review the intended actions, data boundaries, human approvals, expiry and revocation conditions before deciding.

templates.title: Agent authority granted
templates.subject: AI-agent permissions have been granted
templates.preheader: Review which actions are now permitted.
paragraphs: Authority for AI agent {{agent_display_name}} was activated at {{event_at_local}}.
Approved scope: {{mandate_scope_public}}. The grant remains subject to policy evaluation, trust checks, quotas and revocation.

templates.title: Agent authority changed
templates.subject: AI-agent permissions changed
templates.preheader: Review the updated boundaries.
paragraphs: The authority of AI agent {{agent_display_name}} changed at {{event_at_local}}.
